name: number-ticker
blurb: Counter animating from a start value to a target number when scrolled into view.
description: Inline number counter using Framer Motion spring physics. Animates from startValue to value once the element enters the viewport. Supports configurable decimal places and direction (up/down). Delay can defer animation start by N seconds.
use_when: Stat displays, KPI counters, or hero section metrics that reveal as the page scrolls.
avoid_when: Very large numbers (100M+) or extreme precision (10+ decimals) — animation slowdown increases.
a11y: Final number is rendered as text content, readable by screen readers. Animation triggers on viewport visibility.
